title: Keep the four .lore/agents source lists current as bundle concepts are added
description: Measured during the WCLI-24 review (2026-09-28, opum-ai/ward-cli#25): each .lore/agents/*.toml profile declares explicit source lists. Adding a new concept to docs/ (scratch copy: a valid adr/0005-record-format.md with its index link) leaves `lore check --strict` at exit 0, all four pack catalogs unchanged and no warning; the new concept surfaces only as a bundle-wide query hit a specialist must `lore read` by hand. Removal or rename of a referenced id is loud by contrast: `lore agent context` exits 6 with '.lore/agents/<file>.toml references missing concept <id>', `lore check --strict` exits 6, and `lore agent list` errors. So a future ADR that does not touch the four TOMLs is silently absent from every specialist evidence set. Reviewer recommendation: make updating the four source lists part of how an ADR lands here; a Docs-job check (every bundle concept referenced by at least one profile, or explicitly recorded as excluded) is the automating alternative.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A mechanism is decided and recorded (Docs-job check or a recorded ADR-landing step), with the rejected alternative and its reason stated
The chosen mechanism is demonstrated: the current bundle and profiles report clean, and a scratch-added concept is either reported or recorded as a deliberate exclusion

plan: 2. Decide the mechanism (a Docs-job coverage check vs a recorded ADR-landing step) and record it as ADR 0008 with the rejected alternative and its reason.

3. Add scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs: read the bundle concepts from `lore graph --json` and each profile's pinned+sources from `lore agent list/show --json`; fail when a concept is referenced by no profile and is not in the script's explicit exclusion list, and fail rather than pass when it read zero concepts or zero profiles.
4. Reference ADRs 0005-0007 from the profiles that need them, measuring each pack against its max_tokens budget before and after so the fix does not truncate what it means to add.
5. Wire the check into the Docs CI job so the invariant is a required check rather than a convention.
6. Demonstrate, as separate measurements: clean tree green; a scratch-added concept reported by name; the exclusion path green; and the zero-input positive control failing.
7. `lore sync`, `lore check --strict` exit 0, `bun run check` green; independent review over the diff; PR into dev; promote dev to main.
